verdict.rationale: Docs say plugins connect ChatGPT to work tools and information such as Google Drive and SharePoint, which covers cloud drives. Gmail appears only as a scheduled-task event trigger (e.g., triaging new email), and a community comment praises plugin-based retrieval over documents. Missing for 10: any evidence of a calendar connector, explicit documentation that connected email can be searched and cited in chat answers, and independent hands-on corroboration of connector search quality.
